title: In process of C2SoftApvDec.cpp, there is a possible out-of-bounds read due to a logic error in the code (CVE-2026-58933)
description: CVE-2026-58933 is a vulnerability involving a possible out-of-bounds read in the process of C2SoftApvDec.cpp caused by a logic error. This flaw may allow remote information disclosure without requiring additional execution privileges or user interaction.
